rationale: Figure 9 visibly shows the source-to-model routes: a B-cell scRNA/gene-token input feeding scLLM and a Q-former projector into Cell-Text Matching/Contrasting in stage 1, and stage 2 paths for Cell-to-Text Generation and Text-to-Cell Generation through Text LLM, Q-former/cross-attention projector, and scLLM.
